scope: Actual Game.unity and production B UI APIs in an isolated QA save profile. Every balance/stage/account/history setup is explicitly synthetic. No real advertisement, payment, or user account is used. Each PNG is an offscreen 1080x1920 render of real live scene/prefab instances after animation settling, with safe-area adapters temporarily paused by Framework2ActualCapture. Reusable control surfaces and sprite contours use the approved artwork; text, values, controls and the gameplay scene remain live. This is visual coverage, not physical-device evidence or a full end-to-end playthrough. Original workflow tests remain separate.
